captions.detailed: This 3D model features a modern tower fan with a slim, vertical rectangular body in a light grey finish. It is mounted on a thick, rounded rectangular black base that provides stable support. A tall vertical grille on the front face exposes an internal black drum impeller, while a small black rotary speed selector knob is positioned on the upper rear face. The base connects to the tower via a vertical revolute joint for oscillation, the internal impeller spins continuously, and the control knob rotates on a separate revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a modern tower fan. The model should include a rounded rectangular black base, a tall grey vertical rectangular housing, an internal black drum impeller visible through a front cutout, and a small black rotary dial on the upper rear face. Incorporate appropriate revolute joints for the base oscillation, the impeller rotation, and the speed dial.
captions.factory: The object is constructed using four main parts. The base is created by extruding a 2D sketch with rounded corners. The main housing is formed from a tall box with a front rectangular slot cut out to accommodate the impeller. The impeller is represented by a vertical cylinder. The speed selector dial is constructed using a small cylinder. Revolute and continuous joints are defined to link the base to the housing, the housing to the internal impeller, and the housing to the rear dial.
